author: Yffe
content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_battery_vacuous.rs::battery_view_reports_gate_vacuity_reject demonstrates the divergence. Input: the conformance/vacuity/triage.json reject fixture ens_is_true (fn f() -> () req true ens true fx pure { }). Expected (thermite-design.md §7.1 (a) + goal-repl.md REQ-1: a VIEW that re-defines no verdict): the battery render surfaces the gate's EnsIsTrivial reject. Actual: 'vacuity: non-vacuous (tautology=false, vacuous_precondition=false)' + 'mutants killed: 0/0', exit 0 — because Certificate::rejected keeps contract_quality at forward_declared() (NOT-ASSERTED bools) and goal_repl::render_battery_item reads only the bools, never cert.reject. render_goal_item handles the same cert correctly (NOT CERTIFIED — EnsIsTrivial). Committed failing (un-ignored) per the divergence_* house pattern — the block until the generator fixes.
